extracted.description: Produce a breakdown of fire causes by geographical region, restricted to fires whose start month is January, February, or March.
Exclude fires with unknown, missing, or undetermined causes; only fires with known causes may enter the breakdown and the statistical test.
Compute a chi-square statistic from the contingency table of geographical region versus fire cause category for January–March fires with known causes.
Compute the p-value corresponding to the chi-square test on the same region-by-cause contingency table.

stored.description: Produce a breakdown of fire causes by geographical region, restricted to fires whose start month is January, February, or March.
acceptanceCriteria: The breakdown is organized by geographical region, with cause categories distinguished within each region.
Only fires starting in January, February, or March are included in the breakdown.
All geographical regions with qualifying fires in the dataset are represented in the breakdown.
Cause counts in the breakdown are non-negative and their total equals the number of qualifying fires.

assertions.description: Produce a breakdown of fire causes by geographical region, restricted to fires whose start month is January, February, or March.

stored.description: Exclude fires with unknown, missing, or undetermined causes; only fires with known causes may enter the breakdown and the statistical test.
acceptanceCriteria: Records with unknown, missing, null, or undetermined cause values are excluded from the region-cause breakdown.
The same known-cause restriction applies to the contingency table used in the statistical test.
No excluded-cause records contribute to any reported count or statistic.

assertions.description: Exclude fires with unknown, missing, or undetermined causes; only fires with known causes may enter the breakdown and the statistical test.

stored.description: Compute a chi-square statistic from the contingency table of geographical region versus fire cause category for January–March fires with known causes.
acceptanceCriteria: The chi-square statistic is computed on the region-by-cause contingency table built from the filtered fires.
The reported statistic is a single non-negative finite number.
The statistic is consistent with the reported contingency table (same cells, same expected-frequency computation).

assertions.description: Compute a chi-square statistic from the contingency table of geographical region versus fire cause category for January–March fires with known causes.

stored.description: Compute the p-value corresponding to the chi-square test on the same region-by-cause contingency table.
acceptanceCriteria: The p-value is derived from the same chi-square test as the reported statistic, with matching degrees of freedom.
The p-value is a single number in the range 0 to 1 inclusive.

assertions.description: Compute the p-value corresponding to the chi-square test on the same region-by-cause contingency table.
